description: This PHP file defines the EndpointArnMiddleware class in the Aws\S3Control namespace. It implements middleware to handle Amazon S3 ARN parsing and endpoint modification, specifically for access point and bucket ARNs, including Outposts ARNs. It contains methods for validation, ARN replacement, and endpoint URL generation.

classes.name: EndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling ARN-based endpoint modifications and validations in AWS S3 control operations.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper with provided service, region, config, and endpoint version flag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, service, region, config, and endpoint version flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware execution function that processes commands and requests, handling ARN parsing, replacement, and endpoint URL adjustments.

methods.name: generateOutpostsArnHost
methods.description: Generates the hostname for Outposts ARNs based on ARN data and configuration.

methods.name: generateOutpostIdHost
methods.description: Generates the hostname for Outpost ID based endpoint.

methods.name: validateBucketArn
methods.description: Validates that an ARN is a valid S3 bucket ARN.

methods.name: validateAccessPointArn
methods.description: Validates that an ARN is a valid S3 access point ARN.

methods.name: validateArn
methods.description: Performs common validation for an ARN, checking partition, region, and FIPS configurations.
